last_result.headline: Q58 corrected its own premise by reading the code: the structural-field stage does NOT depend on the PF -- struct is an IDW field over same-group train wells, already saved for all 3.72M rows -- so only W and the gate were fitted against the forward PF and the re-fit is arithmetic, not a re-run. The deployed line is now REPRODUCED EXACTLY (8.8626, 9 of 3.72M rows differing by <=0.0182 float32 rounding, gated 87.3%), with W recovered from the deployed column itself at median 0.1500. Finding a future round would have tripped on: the deployed gate uses struct_oof.npz's per-well meta, NOT the aligned frame's nnb/closest_surv columns, which disagree on 6 boundary wells. The NS=64 row-level PF producer is in flight, ETA ~02:50 UTC.
